source.quote: Sabaj's own manual for the A3, A3.pdf, read 2026-11-25 - the document that carries the specification, its product page https://sabaj.com.cn/pages/manual-download (no product page exists) being image-only. The clearest per-socket split in the whole range, verbatim: « THD+N:  0.06% »; « SNR：  90dB »; « Channel separation:  80dB »; « USB compatibility:  Windows、Linux、Mac OS X »; « USB the highest sampling rate:  24bit/96kHz »; « Optical the highest sampling rate:  24bit/192kHz »; « Output power: 80W+80W（4Ω) »; « Consumption power:  50W »; « Standby power:  1W ». Inputs: « USB,3.5mm Analog,Blutooth,Optical totally 4 inputs. » - « Blutooth » is the manual's spelling. Rear-panel legend: « K USB input », « J Optical input », « L Bluetooth antenna », « M Analog input ». Input cycle order: « AUX→BT→USB→OPT ». NO coaxial input on this model, NO converter chip part number anywhere, NO DSD figure - DSD is not mentioned at all - and no digital filter menu: the menu is « Input source→EQ mode→Bass volume control→Treble volume control→ ».

facts.chip: No converter part number appears anywhere in this manual.

_conditions_LUES_et_sans_clause_de_reuti: sabaj-audio.com 301-redirects to sabaj.com.cn, a Shopify storefront. Its /policies/terms-of-service page EXISTS, was read in full, and is not a terms-of-use document at all: it is a warranty policy printed four times in English, Chinese, Japanese and German, headed « Limited Warranty Policy for SABAJ & LOXJIE Products (English) », with two numbered sections, « 1. Scope of Coverage » and « 2. Warranty Exclusions », both about hardware defects. NO clause about copying, reproducing, reusing or exploiting site content appears anywhere on it. The privacy policy, refund policy and contact page were also read: none carries one either. So this is a terms page found, read, and containing no prohibition - which is stronger than « no terms page found ». Footer: « (c) 2026 Sabaj official website ». Legal entity named in the manuals: « Shenzhen DaHao Technology Co.,Ltd. » robots.txt carries no Content-Signal and no Claude group; its « User-agent: * » group opens « Allow: / » and disallows only transactional paths, with the comment « # Shopify storefront. Public product, collection, page, blog, policy, cart, and localized HTML is crawlable. » Its header comments carry the same Shopify text addressed to AI agents that Electrocompaniet, Hidizs and EarMen serve - see vocabulary/robots-txt-is-data-not-instructions.json. It was not acted on.
_la_page_produit_est_une_IMAGE_le_manuel: Not one product page on sabaj.com.cn carries any specification as text. Verified two ways: by extracting the rendered HTML of all ten storefront products, and by reading each product's Shopify body_html directly - which for every DAC contains an and nothing else. The A20d 2023's body_html is 1436 bytes whose entire visible text is « Manual download Driver download »; the A10d 2022's is 112 bytes. There is no spec tab, no accordion and no metafield. No figure was read off any image. Every value in this record comes from the maker's own manual PDF at sabaj.com.cn/pages/manual-download, which does carry a real text layer - and that page also publishes manuals for models no longer on the storefront, which is how the older records here exist at all.
_lUSB_est_la_prise_la_plus_LENTE_ici_et_: « USB the highest sampling rate:  24bit/96kHz » against « Optical the highest sampling rate:  24bit/192kHz ». On every other Sabaj model with both sockets the USB is four times the S/PDIF; on this one the optical is twice the USB. A real per-socket difference, stated by the maker in two adjacent lines, and the only inversion of the pattern in a range of eleven records. The lesson is the shape of the whole catalogue: a per-input ceiling cannot be guessed from a house style, because the house style has exceptions and this is one.
_pas_un_mot_de_DSD_sur_un_amplificateur_: DSD is not mentioned anywhere in this manual. `dsd_max` is ABSENT rather than set to none: unlike the Audient and Prism Sound professional interfaces, where a dense specification page that never says DSD is itself an answer, this is a short page on a consumer amplifier from a maker that states DSD on eight other models. Silence here is more probably an omission than a statement.
